implementation.name: 1942 (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 36 HDL source files (1 systemverilog, 29 verilog, 6 vhdl) alongside 3 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: this core predates the MRA format and ships no .mra file, but its ROM recipe names the MAME set outright -- https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-1942_MiSTer/blob/master/_releases/build_rom.ini reads zip=1942.zip. That is the same fact an MRA <setname> carries, read from a different file. License: the repository has no LICENSE, COPYING or COPYRIGHT file; the grant lives in the source header at https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-1942_MiSTer/blob/master/Arcade-1942.sv, which offers the work under the GNU General Public License "either version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-2.0-or-later. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 36 source files (1 systemverilog, 29 verilog, 6 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
